summary: The diff implements REQ-39 (search functionality) and REQ-40 (mobile dropdown scrolling) with proper evidence. However, REQ-38 (replacing all service card images with professional photos) and REQ-41 (generating professional service photos) show incomplete implementation. While services.ts references new image paths in assets/generated/, the actual image files are not present in the diff (no ADDED FILES section shows generated images). The BuildRequest explicitly required 16 specific professional service photos to be generated and integrated, but these files are missing from the implementation.

missing_requirements.reason: While services.ts references new image paths like '/assets/generated/furniture-repair.dim_800x600.png' and '/assets/generated/door-window-fixing.dim_800x600.png', the diff shows 0 ADDED FILES. The 16 required professional service photos specified in 'Images required' section are not present in the diff.
